recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, minimalist white layout featuring a central title constructed from intricate mechanical components like pipes, gears, and valves in a black-and-white engraving style, paired with light, airy sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-detail mechanical illustrations against stark white negative space
Contrast between heavy industrial forms and delicate, thin-weight text
Horizontal alignment of complex imagery with simple, structured lists
Monochromatic black ink on white paper aesthetic
coreInvariants: Mechanical/Industrial object assemblage for the primary logo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mechanical title is centered on the right panel, acting as the primary focal point. The tracklist is positioned in the upper-left quadrant of the left panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, complex mechanical lettering on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the complex mechanical logo, move down to the subtitle, then sweep across the spine to the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space creates a clinical, modern, and high-contrast environment.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black ink for all illustrations and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (white) vs. low value (black) with no mid-tone saturation.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title glyphs are built from 19th-century industrial parts (pipes, gauges, cogs)
Secondary text uses ultra-light stroke weights with open counters
Numerical lists use a consistent vertical baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are replaced by functional-looking machinery that mimics the letter's silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Complex, illustrative display type paired with a minimal, geometric sans-serif for legibility.

avoid: Heavy bold fonts for body text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, thin-weight sans-serif used for the tracklist.
Required for the custom mechanical lettering style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-resolution pure white canvas. In the center-right, place a complex horizontal arrangement of black-and-white engraved mechanical parts (pipes, valves, gears, pressure gauges) that loosely form a word. The style should resemble 19th-century technical patents or woodcut engravings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a very thin, light-weight sans-serif font, add a numbered list in the top-left corner. Add a small subtitle in a stylized, thin geometric font directly under the mechanical logo. Ensure all text is solid black with no effects.

verificationChecks: Are the mechanical letters composed of distinct industrial parts?
Is the tracklist font ultra-light and clean?
Is the entire composition strictly monochrome?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of negative space to subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeds into the monochrome design.
Check that the mechanical parts are clearly defined and not a blurry mass.
Verify that the thin text remains legible against the white background.
Confirm the layout maintains a distinct left-right panel division.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Engraving + Minimalist White Space + Ultra-Light Sans-Serif = Modern Steampunk Aesthetic
